mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with wage inflation and increased corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it indicates a weak labor market with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: weak labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 50bps in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST YoY < -10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000 in a month.
